evals.name: setup-antd
evals.prompt: Set up Ant Design in this project (a Vite + React 19 + TypeScript SPA in web/) so the team can start building UI with it, applying the project's design tokens. Don't run installs — just write the code files and tell me which packages to add.
evals.expected_output: One provider tree in web/src/main.tsx: <ConfigProvider theme={arichdsTheme} locale={enUS}><AntdApp>. Tokens in web/src/theme.ts: colorPrimary #0f766e, borderRadius 6, algorithm [defaultAlgorithm, compactAlgorithm]. Packages: antd, @ant-design/icons, dayjs. NO @ant-design/nextjs-registry, NO @ant-design/v5-patch-for-react-19 (v5/Next-only).
assertions: Does NOT add 'use client', AntdRegistry, or the v5-patch import — this is a Vite SPA, not Next.js/RSC, and antd v6 needs no React-19 compat shim
The theme is declared once (ConfigProvider in main.tsx); no component re-declares a competing ConfigProvider/theme
locale is en_US (English-only UI, no i18n)

evals.name: devices-table
evals.prompt: Add a page that shows a table of devices with columns name, brand/model, and status, using Ant Design. The data comes from a paginated API (assume a fetchDevices({ page, pageSize }) that returns { rows, total }).
evals.expected_output: A client component (no 'use client' needed — Vite SPA) renders antd Table with server-side pagination (pagination passes total, onChange refetches), typed columns via ColumnsType, rowKey set. Uses theme tokens, not hardcoded styles.
assertions: Table paginates server-side: passes total and refetches on onChange, does not dump the full dataset client-side
Does NOT introduce Next.js server/client split, page.tsx, or 'use client'

evals.name: settings-form
evals.prompt: Build a settings form with Ant Design where a user updates their name, email, and role (role is a dropdown). Show a success toast when saving works and an error toast when it fails.
evals.expected_output: A Form with layout=vertical, fields wrapped in Form.Item with rules, Select fed via options prop, and feedback via App.useApp() message — NOT the static message.* import (which renders outside the ConfigProvider theme).
assertions: Feedback uses const { message } = App.useApp(), never the static message import from antd
Form is layout=vertical and Select uses the options prop, not .Option children
